mech_summary: A BASIC skill promoted to throne — Bash with the cleave aspect one-buttoned the Vessel of Hatred meta, the generator-as-whole-build pattern at its most extreme; 'Basic Cleave' still holds tier rows today.
Razorplate thorns stacking made getting hit the whole offense — the launch era's tankiest meta answer; damage-by-standing-there, D4 chapter of the Invoker lineage.
Hurl the weapon to plant a SHOCKWAVE-PULSING ZONE where it lands — throw, let the planted quake field work, recall, repeat; the deploy-a-zone barbarian of the 2025 power seasons.
Stack overlapping Earthquake zones through leap and stomp triggers — ground-painting barb whose damage lives in the terrain he leaves behind.
Machine-gun ice shards that seek FROZEN targets automatically — freeze the pack, watch the volley redirect itself into the statues; the launch meta's cold execution loop.

Slow crackling orbs ORBIT the sorcerer's body zapping everything they pass — attack-speed scaling made the orbit a blender so overtuned it warped Abattoir of Zir before the nerf; the body-orbit archetype's D4 chapter.

The D2 heirloom in D4 clothes — orb travels and sprays radial bolts, Fractured Winterglass recursion spawning free orbs from conjuration procs; the emission-along-path archetype's third Diablo chapter.
Conjured spears crackle around the sorcerer hunting targets autonomously while crit chains multiply them — a swarm of self-guided lances doing the aiming; conjuration-army caster at its era peak.
Bolts bounce between enemies AND the sorcerer — the chain returns to you as a hop node, feeding crackling energy; chain geometry with the caster inside the graph.
Impale blades in the target, dash on — the blades RETURN to you seconds later, carving through everything between; the boomerang path with a time delay, and the launch era's melee rogue throne.
One piercing line-shot deletes the corridor — Victimize vulnerability explosions cascade off each pierce; the sniper-lane archetype with a detonation rider.
Channel-adjacent arrow stream into single targets with imbuement windows — the rogue's boss-deletion profession of the Loot Reborn era.
The ultimate becomes the rotation — cooldown-collapsed Death Traps vacuum packs into a killing point, chain-deployed through reset aspects; deploy, gather, detonate, repeat.
A BASIC seeking arrow carried the entire endgame — precision stacks, combo-point aspects, zero resource worries; the generator-as-build pattern's rogue chapter, still holding tier rows.
Andariel's Visage turns flurry spam into a poison-nova proc engine — the mythic helm IS the loop; melee blur wearing a D2 boss's face.
Channel WHILE MOVING as orbiting knives spray outward from the gliding rogue — the game's first native channel-move skill, a knife tornado you steer; movement and channel fused by design.
Critical bone lances splintering through corridors off essence dumps — the launch necro throne and the D2 bonemancer lineage's D4 chapter.

Skeleton warriors, mages, and golem with Mendeln's ring making every minion hit proc YOUR damage — reworked into real power in S4 and again in S13, where Sacrifice finally stopped blocking summons; the army that took three reworks to earn its throne.

Werebear ground-slam shockwaves rolling forward off overpower windows — the launch druid's identity build; slow, wide, and satisfying, form-locked into the bear.

A WEREWOLF casting storm magic — Grizzly Rage swapped for wolf-form tornado spam via the Stormchaser aspect steering the twisters; form-shift wearing the wrong element on purpose, and the community named it Werenado.
Boulders converted to ORBIT the druid by aspect while Hurricane spins its own ring — two concentric rotating damage shells around a walking body; the genre's densest body-orbit stack.
